RoleDescription: A clerk helps to manage the economic affairs of the house, and it's finances and cashflow.
CouncilMemberDescription: The Secretary (or 'Executive' in leading houses) is in charge of managing the economic affairs of the house and has a direct impact on its finances and cashflow.

RoleDescription: An officer helps to maintain the military fleet of a house, and will command a ship during a military engagement.
CouncilMemberDescription: The Captain (or Admiral in leading houses) is in charge of maintaing the military fleet of a house and commanding it during a military engagement.

RoleDescription: A messenger helps to maintain positive relationships with other houses.
CouncilMemberDescription: The Diplomat (or Negotiator in leading houses) is in charge of maintaining positive relationships with other houses.

RoleDescription: A bodyguard helps to keep the members of a house safe.
CouncilMemberDescription: The Constable (or Commissioner in leading houses) is in charge of the safety of the members of a house.

RoleDescription: A nurse helps to maintain the health of the members of the house.  They work to prevent medical emergencies and to deal with them effectively when they arise.
CouncilMemberDescription: The Professor (or Doctor in leading houses) is the resident technologist of the house. They are the most skilled at figuring out how to use the inscrutable machines that survive from the Collapse.
